The learned counsel appearing for the State seeks to file a  supplementary counter affidavit, which is taken on record,
 wherein it has been stated that the nature of the land in question  is Gairmajarua Malik land and since the said land has already  been settled in favour of the vendor of the petitioner, the vendor  of the petitioner is required to get the nature of land converted Upendra Singh vs The State Of Bihar on 12 September, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/106201612/
2  from Gairmajarua Malik land to a raiyati category land in terms  of the scheme, notified by the Revenue and Land Reforms  Department, Government of Bihar, Patna, vide Resolution dated  11.11.2014 , which is annexed as Annexure R/6 to the present supplementary counter affidavit.
3. In view of the aforesaid stand taken by the Respondent- State, the leaned counsel for the petitioner seeks liberty on behalf of the vendor of the petitioner to act in terms of the aforesaid Resolution dated 11.11.2014, however, seeks a direction upon the Respondents to do the needful within a fixed time frame as also prays that it be clarified that the aforesaid Resolution dated 11.11.2014 shall be applicable to even those category of Gairmajarua Malik land, which are not under acquisition.

sentences.text:
4. Having regarding to the facts and circumstances of the case, I deem it fit and proper to dispose off the present writ Patna High Court CWJC No.7732 of 2023 dt.12-09-2023 petition with liberty to the vendor of the petitioner to approach the Respondent authorities for change of category of the Gairmajarua Malik land into raiyati category land and in case, appropriate application is filed within a period of four weeks from today, before the District Magistrate, Patna, he shall pass appropriate orders, in accordance with law, within a period of four weeks, thereafter, without being impeded by the fact that the land in question is not under acquisition, inasmuch as it is the stand of the Respondent-State that the aforesaid Resolution dated 11.11.2014 applies to even such cases, where the land in question are not under acquisition.
5.
Accordingly, the present writ petition stands disposed off on the aforesaid terms.

(Mohit Kumar Shah, J) Ajay/-
